# Vendored UI Assets

- `Sortable.min.js`: SortableJS 1.15.7, from the npm distribution at https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.7/Sortable.min.js. MIT license in `sortable-LICENSE.txt`.
- `grip-vertical.svg`: Lucide's grip-vertical icon, from https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/icons/grip-vertical.svg. License in `lucide-LICENSE.txt`.

These files are served locally; the builder does not require external scripts or icon requests at runtime.
